About A M Interior & Renovation Ltd

Building Tomorrow, Today.

A M Interior & Renovation Ltd is a professional construction company focused on quality, reliability and outstanding project delivery. From the first conversation to the final handover, every project is planned carefully, managed transparently and built to a standard we are proud to put our name to.

We bring together experienced site teams, trusted trades and disciplined project management — so clients always know what is happening, what comes next and what it will cost. No surprises, no shortcuts: just well-built work, delivered properly.

Quality & reliability on every build
One accountable point of contact
Transparent pricing & programmes
Safety & standards without compromise

What We Do

Services built around your project

Six core services covering the full journey — from a single extension to a complete commercial build. Select a service to start an enquiry pre-filled for you.

SERVICE — 01

Residential Construction

New-build homes and residential developments constructed with care — sound structure, fine finishes and a programme you can plan around.

SERVICE — 02

Commercial Construction

Offices, retail and commercial buildings delivered to specification — coordinated trades, controlled costs and minimal disruption to your operation.

SERVICE — 03

Renovations & Extensions

Thoughtful renovations, refurbishments and extensions that respect the existing building while transforming how the space works and feels.

SERVICE — 04

Structural Works

Foundations, reinforced concrete, structural steel and load-bearing alterations — engineered, sequenced and executed with precision.

SERVICE — 05

Project Management

End-to-end coordination of design, procurement, trades and programme — with clear reporting at every milestone so you stay in control.

SERVICE — 06

General Contracting

One accountable contractor for the whole build — labour, materials, subcontractors, quality checks and handover under a single contract.

Why Choose Us

The A M Standard

Six commitments that shape every site we run and every building we hand over.

Quality Craftsmanship

Skilled trades, quality materials and finishes checked against the specification — not just against the clock.

Reliable Project Delivery

Realistic programmes, managed proactively — with early warning and honest options if anything changes.

Professional Team

Experienced site leadership and vetted trades who treat your project — and your property — with respect.

Attention to Detail

Snagging starts on day one. Lines, levels, junctions and finishes are reviewed continuously, not at the end.

Safety & Standards

Method statements, site discipline and compliance built into the programme — everyone home safe, every day.

Transparent Communication

One point of contact, written updates and clear costs — you always know where your project stands.

Our Process

Four stages. No surprises.

A refined, proven sequence that takes your project from first conversation to final handover — with clarity at every step.

01

Consultation

We listen first: your goals, your site, your budget and your timescales. You get honest advice on feasibility and the right route forward.

02

Planning & Design

Drawings, specifications, programme and a clear, itemised quotation — agreed in writing before any work begins on site.

03

Construction & Execution

Our teams build to the agreed programme with regular progress updates, quality checks and strict site safety throughout.

04

Final Handover

A joint inspection, a completed snagging list and all documentation handed over — your building, finished and ready to use.
